rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Here they come! You all ready!?
rows.display_text: 「Here they come! You all ready!?」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: (These guys aren't fighting because they want to, either...)
rows.display_text:
（(These guys aren't fighting because
they want to, either...)）

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: (But there's nothing to do but go through with it...!)
rows.display_text:
（(But there's nothing to do but go
through with it...!)）

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: The Coralian Antibody's after the town behind us! Don't you dare let it through!
rows.display_text:
「The Coralian Antibody's after the town
behind us! Don't you dare let it through!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: If it gets past that line, it's over!
rows.display_text: 「If it gets past that line, it's over!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: This is going to be close-quarters fighting! Since we can't use any wide-area weapons, knock them down one at a time!
rows.display_text:
「This is going to be close-quarters
fighting! Since we can't use any wide-area
weapons, knock them down one at a time!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Hold out five minutes and the Coralian will self-destruct! Just hang in there until then!!
rows.display_text:
「Hold out five minutes and the Coralian
will self-destruct! Just hang in there
until then!!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: So it's finally hit its activity limit...
rows.display_text: 「So it's finally hit its activity limit...」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: We managed to protect the town. Let's just be glad of that for now.
rows.display_text:
「We managed to protect the town. Let's
just be glad of that for now.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Yeah... you're right.
rows.display_text: 「Yeah... you're right.」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: (To keep this from happening again and again, I've got no choice but to stop him...)
rows.display_text:
（(To keep this from happening again
and again, I've got no choice but to stop
him...)）

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: (Dewey... I'm going to walk the path I believe in. Even if you stand in my way...)
rows.display_text:
（(Dewey... I'm going to walk the path I
believe in. Even if you stand in my
way...)）

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Damn it! I can't stop it!!
rows.display_text: 「Damn it! I can't stop it!!」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: Th-this way, the people in the town are gonna...!
rows.display_text:
「Th-this way, the people in the town
are gonna...!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Tch! So it's bottomless until it finally hits its activity limit!
rows.display_text:
「Tch! So it's bottomless until it finally
hits its activity limit!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: No more time to hesitate! There's nothing to do but go through with it!
rows.display_text:
「No more time to hesitate! There's
nothing to do but go through with it!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: They fired the Orange!?
rows.display_text: 「They fired the Orange!?」

rows.speaker: Hap
rows.en: I don't know the details, but it's not far from here.
rows.display_text:
「I don't know the details, but it's not
far from here.」

rows.speaker: Renton
rows.en: If that's been used, does that mean a Coralian Antibody is going to appear...!
rows.display_text:
「If that's been used, does that mean a
Coralian Antibody is going to appear...!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: No time to waste thinking! Let's move!
rows.display_text: 「No time to waste thinking! Let's move!」

rows.speaker: Talho
rows.en: Move -- where, exactly...!?
rows.display_text: 「Move -- where, exactly...!?」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Isn't it obvious!? To where the Coralian's appearing!
rows.display_text:
「Isn't it obvious!? To where the
Coralian's appearing!」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Are we going to fight, Holland...?
rows.display_text: 「Are we going to fight, Holland...?」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: ...It can't be helped. I can't just leave a Coralian Antibody attacking people alone...
rows.display_text:
「...It can't be helped. I can't just leave
a Coralian Antibody attacking people
alone...」

rows.speaker: Eureka
rows.en: Okay...
rows.display_text: 「Okay...」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: We're putting one warship and eight squads on the town's defense!
rows.display_text:
「We're putting one warship and eight
squads on the town's defense!」

rows.speaker: Holland
rows.en: Five minutes! Hold them off until the Coralian Antibody hits its activity limit!
rows.display_text:
「Five minutes! Hold them off until the
Coralian Antibody hits its activity limit!」
